description: Per-server request limits the library applies by default, keyed by hostname. concurrency is the most requests in flight to the server at once; minInterval is the shortest time between two requests starting, in milliseconds. Each entry keeps under what its registry publishes, or is cautious where a registry says it limits but gives no number. A server not listed gets the default (2 in flight, 250 ms apart, about 4 a second). Registries checked that publish nothing, and so get the default: Verisign (.com, .net), PIR (.org), CentralNic, GoDaddy Registry, EURid, SIDN, CIRA, IIS, auDA. Identity Digital publishes 10 queries a second per address on WHOIS and RDAP, which the default already keeps under. Checked 2026-11-16. Set updated to the date of any change to the limits.

whois.nic.uk.note: 5 queries a second, and 1,000 per rolling 24 hours, which a spacing cannot express

whois.punktum.dk.note: 1 request a second per source address; going over it bans the address for a while

whois.denic.de.note: limited per /24 network, with no number published

whois.nic.ch.note: limits accesses per unit of time, with no number published; once it limits an address it answers with a short refusal

whois.nic.li.note: the same registry and terms as whois.nic.ch

whois.jprs.jp.note: repeated rapid queries are blocked for a while, with no number published
